NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26 (200935 EUECYIYN MAY 2026).
AND TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST MESSAGE 250829 LTAAYNYX DEC 2025.
REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE 291240 LGACYAYC DEC 2025.
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A2143/26 (200935 EUECYIYN MAY 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS
TO TURKISH MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY
COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC CAA THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE
AIS UNIT AND THE ONLY RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY FOR THE SAFETY OF THE
AIR TRAFFIC IS THE HELLENIC CAA THROUGH THE ATS UNITS.
AS HAS BEEN CONSISTENTLY NOTED IN THE PAST, AND WITH THE REF (B)
291240 LGACYAYC DEC 2025 GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE TO TURKEY, PARTS
OF THE AREA MENTIONED IN TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26 (200935 EUECYIYN MAY
2026) OVERLAP AREAS OF NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY OF GREECE.
FURTHERMORE, THE TURKISH REQUEST ENTAILS LONG-TERM RESERVATION
OF AIRSPACE CONTRARY TO THE RELEVANT ICAO RECOMMENDATIONS.
CONSEQUENTLY, THE AREA AS REQUESTED IS NOT AVAILABLE.
FOR THE ABOVE MENTIONED REASONS THE TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26 (200935 EU
ECYIYN MAY 2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE TO ATHINAI FIR.

properties.originalText: GU..AIRSPACE S. FINEGAYAN, GU..TEMPORARY FLIGHT RESTRICTION. PURSUANT TO 49 USC 40103(B)(3), THE FEDERAL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION (FAA) CLASSIFIES THE AIRSPACE DEFINED IN THIS NOTAM AS 'NTL DEFENSE AIRSPACE'. ANY PERSON WHO KNOWINGLY OR WILLFULLY VIOLATES THE RULES CONCERNING OPS IN THIS AIRSPACE MAY BE SUBJECT TO CERTAIN CRIMINAL PENALTIES UNDER 49 USC SECTION 46307. PILOTS WHO DO NOT ADHERE TO THE FOLLOWING PROC MAY BE INTERCEPTED, DETAINED AND INTERVIEWED BY LAW ENFORCEMENT/SECURITY PERSONNEL. PURSUANT TO 14 CFR 99.7, SPECIAL SECURITY INSTRUCTIONS, ALL ACFT FLT OPS ARE PROHIBITED: WI AN AREA DEFINED AS 133349N1445041E (UNZ043009.2) TO 133308N1445002E (UNZ043008.3) TO 133249N1444908E (UNZ040007.4) THEN CLOCKWISE ON A 0.93NM ARC CENTERED ON 133308N1445002E (UNZ043008.3) TO POINT OF ORIGIN SFC-6000FT EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY UNTIL 2705221859 UTC (0459 LOCAL 05/23/27). THE ABOVE DEFINED AIRSPACE CONTAINS CONTINUOUS MILITARY ACTIVITY WHICH CREATES A SERIOUS HAZARD TO AVIATION. AIRCRAFT FLYING WITHIN THE ABOVE AIRSPACE WILL BE EXPOSED TO DIRECT RADIATION WHICH MAY PRODUCE HARMFUL EFFECTS TO PERSONNEL AND EQUIPMENT. RADIATION IS NOT VISUALLY APPARENT AND SHOULD BE PRESUMED BY ALL PILOTS TO CONTINUOUSLY EXIST. LEE WEBBER, TEL 671-473-1234, IS THE POINT OF CONTACT. GUAM /ZUA/ CERAP, TEL 671-473-1210, IS THE FAA CDN FAC.

NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM A4816/26 (261339 EUECYIYN OCT 2026).
AND TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST MESSAGE 200903 LTAAYNYX OCT 2026.
REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE 261133 LGACYAYC OCT 2026.
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A4816/26 (261339 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS
TO TURKISH MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY
COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER
(HASP) THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE AIS UNIT AND THE ONLY RESPONSIBLE
AUTHORITY FOR THE SAFETY OF THE AIR TRAFFIC IN THE AREA IS THE
HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH THE ATS AND ATC
UNITS.
MOREOVER, AS IT WAS NOTIFIED THROUGH THE REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION 
MESSAGE 261133 LGACYAYC OCT 2026, THE GREEK COMPETENT AUTHORITIES DID
NOT PROMULGATE A NOTAM IN RESPONSE TO REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST 
GIVEN THAT PART OF THE AREA REQUESTED OVERLAPS AREA OF NATIONAL
SOVEREIGNTY OF GREECE. 
FOR ALL THE ABOVE MENTIONED REASONS THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A4816/26 (261339 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT
APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR.

WHICH IS THE ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, AND THEY 
REMAIN UNCHANGED.

THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAMS
A4855/26 AND A4808/26 (281945 AND 260829 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) ARE NULL
AND VOID SINCE THEY REFER TO TURKISH MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN
ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS
IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE INTERNATIONAL RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE
HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH THE HELLENIC ATS
AND AIS UNITS.

SERVICES OPERATED BY CARRIERS HOLDING AN OPERATING LICENSE ISSUED BY
FRANCE, WHETHER THEY ARE CONTRACTUAL CARRIERS AND/OR OPERATING
CARRIERS, OR PERFORMING AIR SERVICES THROUGH A WET LEASE OR A

SECURITY CONDITIONS BEFORE ENTERING THIS AIRSPACE OF OMAN.

NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED: 
REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A4208/26 (130817 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A5134/26 (131101 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM 
A5134/26 (131101 EUECYIYN NOV 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS 
TO ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR, WHERE THE ONLY COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO 
PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO RULES AND REGULATIONS IS 
THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE 
AIS UNIT. 
FURTHERMORE, THE ALLEGATIONS CONTAINED IN TURKISH NOTAM A5134/26 
(131101 EUECYIYN NOV 2026) ARE ERRONEOUS, MISLEADING AND 
DEVOID OF ANY LEGAL BASIS. THERE IS NO OBLIGATION UNDER ANY OF THE 
INTERNATIONAL TREATIES AND CONVENTIONS IN FORCE FOR THE 
DEMILITARIZATION OF THE GREEK ISLAND OF SAMOTHRACE. 
WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF ITS WELL KNOWN AND LONG STANDING POSITIONS, 
WHICH ARE IN FULL COMPLIANCE WITH INTERNATIONAL LAW, GREECE WILL 
CONTINUE TO PLAN AND CONDUCT MILITARY EXERCISES IN THIS AREA, AS 
IT HAS REGULARLY BEEN DOING ALL ALONG. 
FOR ALL THE ABOVE REASONS TURKISH NOTAM A5134/26 (131101 EUECYIYN NOV 
2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS 
UIR. 
THE ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE NOTAM WITHIN ATHINAI FIR IS THE ABOVE 
REF (A) A4208/26 ISSUED BY GREECE. 
FINALLY, THE HELLENIC AUTHORITIES CATEGORICALLY REJECT THE ATTEMPT 
BY TURKIYE TO INTRODUCE IN THE FLOW OF THE NOTAM ISSUING SYSTEM, 
POLITICALLY MOTIVATED STATEMENTS OF POSITIONS, WHICH, BESIDES 
BEING BASELESS, HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH THE FUNDAMENTAL PURPOSE OF THAT SYSTEM, NAMELY THE SAFETY OF AIR NAVIGATION. 
LIKEWISE THE ABOVE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A5134/26 (131101 EUECYIYN 
NOV 2026) USES FALSE NAME TO DESIGNATE THE SPECIFIC GREEK ISLAND INST 
EAD OF ITS INTERNATIONALLY KNOWN NAME.

MILITARY INVASION OF UKRAINE BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION:
ALL RUSSIAN REGISTERED ACFT AND ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR 
OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE 
RUSSIAN FEDERATION ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, LAND IN, TAKE-OFF FROM, 
OR OVERFLY GREEK NATIONAL AIRSPACE, EXCEPT HUMANITARIAN, MEDEVAC AND 
SAR FLIGHTS, OR ANY OTHER FLIGHT, AS IN CASE OF EMERGENCY LANDING OR 
EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT, BY PERMISSION OF THE GOVERNMENT OF THE 
HELLENIC REPUBLIC. ALL ACFT OPERATORS OF NON-SCHEDULED FLIGHTS 
BETWEEN RUSSIA AND GREECE, OPERATED DIRECTLY OR VIA A THIRD COUNTRY, 
SHALL NOTIFY ALL RELEVANT INFORMATION CONCERNING THE FLIGHT,
AT LEAST 48 HOURS IN ADVANCE TO HELLENIC CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY
CONTACT: FLIGHTPERMISSION(AT)HCAA.GOV.GR.

properties.originalText:
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED: 
REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A4237/26 (160836 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A5174/26 (161006 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM 
A5174/26 (161006 EUECYIYN NOV 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS 
TO ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR, WHERE THE ONLY COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO 
PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO RULES AND REGULATIONS IS 
THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE 
AIS UNIT. 
FURTHERMORE, THE ALLEGATIONS CONTAINED IN TURKISH NOTAM A5174/26 
(161006 EUECYIYN NOV 2026) ARE ERRONEOUS, MISLEADING AND DEVOID OF 
ANY LEGAL BASIS. THERE IS NO OBLIGATION UNDER ANY OF THE 
INTERNATIONAL TREATIES AND CONVENTIONS IN FORCE FOR THE 
DEMILITARIZATION OF THE GREEK ISLAND OF LIMNOS. 
WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF ITS WELL KNOWN AND LONG STANDING POSITIONS, 
WHICH ARE IN FULL COMPLIANCE WITH INTERNATIONAL LAW, GREECE WILL 
CONTINUE TO PLAN AND CONDUCT MILITARY EXERCISES IN THIS AREA, AS 
IT HAS REGULARLY BEEN DOING ALL ALONG. 
FOR ALL THE ABOVE REASONS TURKISH NOTAM A5174/26 (161006 EUECYIYN NOV 
2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/HELLAS 
UIR. 
THE ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE NOTAM WITHIN ATHINAI FIR IS THE ABOVE 
REF (A) A4237/26 (160836 EUECYIYN NOV 2026) ISSUED BY GREECE. 
FINALLY, THE HELLENIC AUTHORITIES CATEGORICALLY REJECT THE ATTEMPT 
BY TURKIYE TO INTRODUCE IN THE FLOW OF THE NOTAM ISSUING SYSTEM, 
POLITICALLY MOTIVATED STATEMENTS OF POSITIONS, WHICH, BESIDES 
BEING BASELESS, HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH THE FUNDAMENTAL PURPOSE OF THAT SYSTEM, NAMELY THE SAFETY OF AIR NAVIGATION. 
LIKEWISE THE ABOVE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A5174/26 (161006 EUECYIYN 
NOV 2026) USES FALSE NAME TO DESIGNATE THE SPECIFIC GREEK ISLAND 
INSTEAD OF ITS INTERNATIONALLY KNOWN NAME.

properties.originalText:
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED: 
REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A4295/26 (190900 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A5264/26 (200643 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM 
A5264/26 (200643 EUECYIYN NOV 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS 
TO ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR, WHERE THE ONLY COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO 
PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO RULES AND REGULATIONS IS 
THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE 
AIS UNIT. 
FURTHERMORE, THE ALLEGATIONS CONTAINED IN TURKISH NOTAM A5264/26 
(200643 EUECYIYN NOV 2026) ARE ERRONEOUS, MISLEADING AND DEVOID OF 
ANY LEGAL BASIS. THERE IS NO OBLIGATION UNDER ANY OF THE 
INTERNATIONAL TREATIES AND CONVENTIONS IN FORCE FOR THE 
DEMILITARIZATION OF THE GREEK ISLAND OF AGIOS EFSTRATIOS. 
WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF ITS WELL KNOWN AND LONG STANDING POSITIONS, 
WHICH ARE IN FULL COMPLIANCE WITH INTERNATIONAL LAW, GREECE WILL 
CONTINUE TO PLAN AND CONDUCT MILITARY EXERCISES IN THIS AREA, AS 
IT HAS REGULARLY BEEN DOING ALL ALONG. 
FOR ALL THE ABOVE REASONS TURKISH NOTAM A5264/26 (200643 EUECYIYN NOV 
2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/ 
HELLAS UIR. 
THE ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE NOTAM WITHIN ATHINAI FIR IS THE ABOVE 
REF (A) A4295/26 ISSUED BY GREECE. 
FINALLY, THE HELLENIC AUTHORITIES CATEGORICALLY REJECT THE ATTEMPT 
BY TURKIYE TO INTRODUCE IN THE FLOW OF THE NOTAM ISSUING SYSTEM, 
POLITICALLY MOTIVATED STATEMENTS OF POSITIONS, WHICH, BESIDES 
BEING BASELESS, HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH THE FUNDAMENTAL PURPOSE OF THAT SYSTEM, NAMELY THE SAFETY OF AIR NAVIGATION. 
LIKEWISE THE ABOVE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A5264/26 (200643 EUECYIYN 
NOV 2026) USES FALSE NAME TO DESIGNATE THE SPECIFIC GREEK ISLAND 
INSTEAD OF ITS INTERNATIONALLY KNOWN NAME.
